label: ERW forecast
made_rule: made at 20:00 UTC the day before the target local day, from output through two days before it; no weather enters
units: MW; nmae_pct is the mean absolute error over the mean actual output of the same hours, in percent (a percent of each hour means nothing at night)

methods.words: the method the rule chose for the place and fuel (the lowest mean absolute error of the ERW's methods over the last two years)
the operator's own forecast, where the warehouse holds it (Texas: ERCOT; grid-caiso: CAISO)
the same local hour of the latest whole day read (two days before the target day)
the mean of the same local hour over the seven latest whole days read
least squares by local hour on the latest day's hour and mean, the seven-day mean of the hour and its fourteen-day highest, refit every day on the 365 days before it, never below zero
